svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', DejaVu Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Evolution — phases concept P1b: the seamless move from the dish to the rock pool
svg.desc: Six frames from the warning at 9:50 to playing in the rock pool at 10:12. The player keeps control throughout: the rim dissolves, the pool fades in and the camera eases out by ten, so the dish shrinks to a ring of crumbs beside a rotifer as big as it. Code-drawn.
svg.text: EVOLUTION
· concept P1b — THE SEAMLESS MOVE · chosen on ticket #786 (C)
You never stop steering. The size jump is read from the world around you: the dish shrinks to a tenth, its giants become crumbs, a rotifer as big as the old dish sits beside it.
decided: ticket #786 C · design: docs/game-design/phases.md §14.4
timings are tuning values (§14.14) · zero raster
9:50 · The warning, and you keep playing
The rim thins and brightens; the pool's light already shows
through the dark field; the music swells. Ten seconds to go.
10:00 · The rim dissolves; you are in the pool
One tick: the dish is now a disc at the pool's centre and everyone
arrives at the same small size. The wall drifts away in pieces.

g.text: YOUR DISH WAS ONE POCKET OF SLIME ON A KELP BLADE

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, Consolas, Menlo, monospace

svg.text: 10:01 · The camera eases out by ten
It starts magnified so the dish's outline sits where the rim was,
then eases out over 4 s. The dish visibly shrinks while you steer.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, Consolas, Menlo, monospace

svg.text: 10:04 · The dish is a ring of crumbs
Its wild cells and giants are now the green specks inside the ring.
Beside it, the landmark: one rotifer, as wide as your old world.
10:08 · The grace ends
For 8 s nothing hunted you. Now the Didinium looks for ciliates,
the nematode thrashes past, and the rotifer's whirlpool turns on.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, Consolas, Menlo, monospace

svg.text: 10:12 · The ring fades; you are just playing
Form, colour, traits and score came with you; size did not.
The era chip beside the timer says where you are.
